# JRailPass

> Official reseller of the Japan Rail Pass offering unlimited Shinkansen and JR train travel across Japan with 7, 14, and 21-day passes for tourists.

JRailPass.com is an authorized distributor providing Japan Rail Pass products, regional rail passes covering routes from Tokyo to Osaka, Kyoto, Hokkaido and beyond, plus travel connectivity solutions. The site helps international travelers plan budget-friendly train travel throughout Japan using the JR network and Shinkansen bullet trains.

## Key Topics

- Japan Rail Pass
- JR Pass
- Shinkansen bullet trains
- Exchange Order
- Green Pass (first class)
- Regional rail passes
- Tokyo-Osaka-Kyoto routes
- Unlimited train travel
- JR East network
- Hokuriku Shinkansen
- Tourist pass eligibility
- Travel planning
- Japan travel budget
- Kansai region access
- Pass validity periods
